name: Community — Krea 2
author: Krea AI
description: Six Krea 2 single-pass DiT mixes — Moody Mix, RedCraft Red Mix, Realia, Fascium, BF95 Dark Realism and Dark Beast (fp8). Uncensored/photoreal 8-10 step distilled checkpoints at CFG 1, rendering at native ~2 MP (1408x1408 and equivalents) with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x adds a 4-step detail-refine pass; 1x is a clean single pass), all sharing one Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE, so each extra mix costs only its ~12-14 GB checkpoint. Three of the six (RedCraft, Fascium, Dark Beast) are mature-capable mixes. The trained finetunes (Muse, FinalCut, Binyuan) moved to the separate Krea 2 Finetunes pack in 1.6.0. Since 1.7.0: two free GGUF builds of Dark Beast (Q8 matches the FP8 original, Q4 fits 8 GB cards), because the FP8 file is paid on Civitai. Since 1.8.0: two cards from VXP's experimental Krea 2 beta series (INT8, about 14 s a picture at 1 MP): Beta 4 for anime and illustration, Beta 3 for the same look on photographs. Both put a dark, backlit, high-contrast grade on everything, which none of the other cards here give. Since 1.9.0: DaSiWa Krea2 DarkDesire V3 (Darksidewalker, INT8), added on request; it stays close to stock Krea 2 Turbo, with richer painted skies, bolder anime lines and deeper reds.

presets.name: Moody Krea 2 Mix V1.0
presets.description:
Uncensored, moody photoreal pictures with warm, freckled, natural skin. The best skin texture and natural anatomy of the Krea cards.

It renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail pass that came out clean at 1.5x; 1x is a clean single pass.

About 25 seconds for a 1408 px picture on a 12 GB card, and Upscale 1.5 adds about 10 seconds. 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB, in about 70 seconds.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Uncensored mix. Renders at ~2 MP natively (Krea 2 supports 1K-2K); 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes ~3x longer. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass, as in the official Krea 2 Turbo preset; at Upscale 1 the refine is bypassed by a core ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode gate, because a same-size refine pass blotches skin on these mixes (tested 4 sampler/denoise variants, all bad; 1.5x is clean). Measured 2026-09-01: 1408x1408 in ~25 s on a 4070 Ti (~20 s at 1 MP); Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~10 s. 2048x2048 direct: ~70 s. All six presets were verified at Upscale 1 and 1.5 with the gate in place.

presets.name: Dark Beast Krea 2 (FP8)
presets.description:
Uncensored, bold and fast: a high-contrast film look with pale skin and wider, more environmental framing. This is the 2x-speed edition, so you can try 6 steps.

For new installs: the creator has made this FP8 file paid on Civitai, so it will not download here unless you have bought it there (a one-off Buzz unlock, not a subscription). If you have not, use the Dark Beast GGUF cards instead, which are free and give the same picture.

If you do own it and install the file by hand rather than letting the card fetch it, take the 11.94 GB fp8 build, not the 20.68 GB one: the card is set up for the smaller file.

It renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail pass that came out clean at 1.5x; 1x is a clean single pass.

About 34 seconds for a 1408 px picture on a 12 GB card, and Upscale 1.5 adds about 7 seconds. 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes about 3 times longer.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, plain fp8 - all F8_E4M3) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Uncensored "Aggressive Edition" (2x-speed distill). NOTE: the model PAGE also has an INT8 ConvRot version - do NOT use that one (INT8 blocked on engine v0.26.0 like Ideogram); we use the FP8 file. Pinned to Civitai's 11.94 GB fp8 file (version 3078453, fileId 2958418). That version also publishes a 20.68 GB build; an early user who received that one got a 20 GB download followed by 'model isn't installed'. Re-checked 2026-11-07: the page is now 'DarkBeast 6X | 黑兽' and both files were renamed (pinned file darkbeast6X_darkBeast2K2TFP8_fp8.safetensors, primary; the large one darkbeast6X_darkBeast2K2TFP8_full_fp8.safetensors), so they no longer share a filename. THE PAYWALL IS STILL UP: version 3078453 reports paidAccess permanent true, endsAt null. Its availability and earlyAccessConfig are both null, which is NOT a free signal - those fields describe early access, a different mechanism, and reading them instead of paidAccess produced a wrong 'the block is lifted' edit in 1.10.1, reverted here. A user who downloaded it at full speed that day had unlocked it with Buzz. The GGUF version 3092542 reports paidAccess null and is genuinely free. Renders at ~2 MP natively (Krea 2 supports 1K-2K); 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes ~3x longer. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass, as in the official Krea 2 Turbo preset; at Upscale 1 the refine is bypassed by a core ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode gate, because a same-size refine pass blotches skin on these mixes (tested 4 sampler/denoise variants, all bad; 1.5x is clean). presets.name: Dark Beast Krea 2 (GGUF Q8)
presets.tagline: Aggressive uncensored Krea 2, the free Q8 build
presets.description:
The free build of Dark Beast, for when you cannot download the FP8 file, which is paid on Civitai. In our side-by-side it gave the same picture as the FP8 original for the same seed: uncensored, bold and high-contrast.

It is a 14.6 GB download. If disk space or VRAM matters more than an exact match, use the Q4 card.

About 40 seconds for a 1408 px picture on a 12 GB card. It renders at about 2 MP, and the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail pass.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT as GGUF (diffusion_models) through UnetLoaderGGUFDynamicVRAM + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. Q8_0 GGUF, 14,563,660,832 B, sha256 0C832D89..., Civitai model 2749127 (molbal) version 3092542 file 2972074: a conversion of AiMetatron's version 3078453, the file the FP8 card ships. FILENAME CHANGED in 1.10.3 (2026-11-08), was darkBeastKrea2Aggressive_v10_q80.gguf. Until the store fix of 2026-11-07 the community sync merged this card's and the Q4 card's file ids into one URL, so this card served the Q4 file (version primary) under the Q8 name and the sync recorded the Q4 hash for both; a user's engine read it as Q4_0 and staged 7314MB. The app skips a file that already exists, so anyone holding the old name kept the Q4 weights after the fix; the new name (Civitai's own name for file 2972074) makes every install fetch the real Q8. Do not change it back. Tested 2026-10-04 in plain ComfyUI 0.37.2 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB with molbal/ComfyUI-GGUF 48de657, 2 prompts x 2 seeds at 1408x1408 against the FP8 file: same composition and subject on 4 of 4 (24-31 dB), 47-78 s against 29-33 s. Verified in the SimpliGen app 2026-10-06 (engine 0.38.0, 4070 Ti 12 GB): 3 prompts per card at ~2 MP, 6 of 6 clean, 39-40 s each (4 s/step); the Q8 and Q4 portraits are byte-identical to the plain-ComfyUI renders of the same seed. Uses the fork's UnetLoaderGGUFDynamicVRAM with reclaimVramBeforeSampling; its legacy UnetLoaderGGUF ran 60-110 s/step here. The standard city96 loader cannot read this file ("Unexpected architecture type in GGUF file: 'krea2'"), so the card needs the molbal fork. Same graph as the FP8 card apart from the loader: euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed, gated 4-step refine above Upscale 1.

presets.name: VXP Krea 2 Beta 4 (Anime)
presets.description:
Backlit, high-contrast anime and illustration, from an experimental beta series. It puts one look on everything: strong backlight, rim-lit hair, deep shadows and a dark grade. In our side-by-side none of the other Krea 2 cards gave that picture.

Anime and semi-real illustration are its home ground. It also turns photo prompts into illustration, so use Beta 3 or a realism card for photographs.

Uncensored, but on clothed prompts it kept the clothes on in our test.

About 14 seconds a picture at 1 MP on a 12 GB card, and 24-26 seconds at 1216x1632. Upscale above 1 and LoRAs are untested on this card.

Licence (Civitai): credit not required, no derivatives or merges, commercial use limited to generation services.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models): Civitai model 2938537, version 3375540 'Beta 4 (Anime) INT8', file 3263832, 13,320,458,040 B, SHA256 d5eba08564bd3891ad7143463e9c3c8096dea6667b458ac7b46720aeb47f0a65; + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards (the files on the model page are byte-identical to them). euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Tested 2026-10-08 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 6 prompts x 3 seeds at 1024x1536 against base Krea 2 Turbo, Equinox, Moody, BF95 Dark Realism and Dark Beast, all at 8 steps / CFG 1. Median 14 s per picture. The author publishes no settings; a probe showed 4, 8 and 12 steps at CFG 1 clean and 20 steps at CFG 3.5 as heavy noise, so there is no CFG slider. LICENCE (Civitai): credit not required, no derivatives/merges, commercial use limited to generation services. Verified in the app 2026-10-08 (SimpliGen 1.71.0, engine 0.38.0): 3 seeds at 1216x1632 (3:4), all rendered in 24-26 s, queued checkpoint, seed, steps and sampler read back from the engine. Upscale above 1 and LoRAs not tested on this card.

presets.name: DaSiWa Krea2 DarkDesire V3 (INT8)
presets.tagline: Darksidewalker's Krea 2 mix: richer anime skies, darker accents; close to stock
presets.description:
Krea 2 Turbo pushed toward a darker, anime-friendly style by Darksidewalker, the maker of our DaSiWa H3 packs. In our side-by-side test it stayed close to stock Krea 2 Turbo, with the same compositions from the same seed. The differences are richer, more painted skies and backgrounds, slightly bolder lines on anime prompts and deeper reds on dark scenes. It is here because the community asked for it.

About 22 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

Mature-capable.

Civitai asks for a sign-in to download (API key). The author does not allow merges of it. Licence (Civitai): image use and on-site generation allowed; no derivatives.

presets.name: RedCraft Krea 2 Red Mix 3.0
presets.tagline: Red Mix 3.0: darker, more dramatic uncensored realism
presets.description:
Uncensored Krea 2 realism with a darker, more dramatic grade than Red Mix 1.1: deeper shadows, stronger contrast and more striking light, such as light shafts and coloured glow. In our test, faces, skin and composition stayed close to 1.1.

AiMeASOP's Red Mix 3.0 (赤佬 3.0), a merge of Krea 2 Raw and Turbo. The author says 3.0 removes mosaics and improves visual effects. RedCraft Krea 2 Red Mix (1.1) stays in the pack if you prefer its lighter look.

Write plain sentences. Krea 2 ignores negative prompts at CFG 1.

This card uses the author's Euler at 10 steps and CFG 1, about 48 seconds a picture at 2 MP on a 12 GB card. The author suggests 8 to 12 steps. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass.
